novelty_flags.label: thm:strict-extension-of-anchor
novelty_flags.one_line: The flagship-aspirant strict-extension claim names only ShingakiYoshidaKuroki2026 and does not state a comparison against a second published estimator or a generic published comparator class, so it is capped at field.

novelty_flags.label: prop:tian-pearl-reduction
novelty_flags.one_line: The proposition is the already-published TianPearl2000 exogeneity-plus-monotonicity PN/PS reduction, so it should be retained only as a validation corollary rather than presented as a research result.

soundness_flags.label: prop:known-selection-margins
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed margin formula follows directly by substituting P(E=e,S=1)=s_e m_e and normalizing; it has no independent theorem-level mathematical content.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:separated-wald and the first-order portion of thm:confidence-fiber-coverage
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Regular Wald conclusions are conditional on the explicitly defined separated rigid stratum, smooth chart continuation, proportional margin sampling, and nonsingular target covariance.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Asymptotic normality and Wald/Hausdorff conclusions hold only on compact subsets of the separated rigid stratum; transition laws receive the coverage-only confidence-fiber claim.
